text:
Sam Ortega: Quick heads up — Zenlytic wants a 6mo private POC. Asking for 28% off list + waived onboarding. They can prepay $130k if we accept. Need deal-desk advise.

Jules Park: 28% is high. Whats the usage estimate?

Riley Matthews: Ballpark: 900M tokens/mo -> ~$27k/mo list -> ~$162k over 6mo. Infrastructure for eu-west private: 1-2 GPUs, ~10k-15k infra cost. Onboarding labor ~8-12k.

Sam Ortega: Customer says $130k upfront. They want eu-west1 and strict residency.

Dana Ortiz (deal-desk): We usually cap pilot discounts at 20% without conversion commitment. Options: 1) 15% + $10k onboarding credit, 2) 22% if they prepay >=$150k, 3) 20% + convertible 12mo clause.

LegalBot: Residency + data retention needs explicit DPA language. Customer wants "no prompt retention"; propose 60-90 day retention window in DPA.

sec-bot: Checklist: SOC2 present, KMS plan pending, VPC diagram needed. Retention 60 days likely ok if DPA signed.

Jules Park: If they can only do $130k, recommend 15% + $10k credit. Net still covers costs and keeps margin.

Riley Matthews: Ops can soft-provision on receipt of wire confirmation for smoke tests. No keys until KMS signed. Provision time ~8 biz days.

Dana Ortiz (deal-desk): I'm +1 for 15% + $10k credit contingent on $130k wire and signed DPA. I'll route to Finance once we have docs and SecOps sign-off.

Sam Ortega: I'll push procurement for the wire and attach a DPA draft. If they confirm wire + DPA, we accept 15% + $10k credit. Holding exec escalation.

(End of thread)
